''See also: [[Iron Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Iron refers to a significant stage of [[advancement]] within the [[Foundation]] realm, following [[Copper]] and preceding [[Jade]]. Achieving this level provides a quantitative leap in power, granting practitioners superhuman capabilities that far exceed those at the [[Copper stage]] or below. An [[Iron body]] offers increased durability, such as toughness exceeding snake leather, and allows for impressive physical feats. While practitioners still require food and sleep, they gain enhanced resilience against physical injuries like pulled muscles or bleeding. However, the transformation process can be a gruesome experience involving the expulsion of impurities from the body. There are various specialized types of Iron bodies, each offering unique advantages. The [[Steelborn body]] is renowned for providing immense brute strength, particularly at higher levels of [[advancement]]. The [[Bloodforged Iron body]] is designed to resist corrosive breakdown, though it consumes [[madra]] rapidly. The [[Moonheart Iron body]] allows a practitioner to separate their consciousness from their physical form, ensuring that bodily trauma does not disrupt mental or spiritual control. Additionally, the [[Silverscale Iron body]] is used to fortify a [[spirit]]'s natural control and provide resistance against spiritual attacks. In terms of [[madra]], Iron-quality energy is more powerful than lower tiers and can be used to fuel advanced equipment, such as flying swords capable of levitation and combat. The term also describes individuals who have reached this stage of cultivation.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Following the [[Copper stage]], Iron serves as a power stage of [[advancement]] that can be reached after walking a [[Path]]. To achieve this rank, an individual must push [[madra]] from their channels into their flesh to completely reforge the body and improve their eyesight. While this stage is lower than [[Jade]], advancing too early carries the risk of crippling a [[sacred artist]]'s future. For [[Lindon]], reaching Iron was a possibility he waited for until he eventually attained the rank.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|An Iron represents a specific stage of progression that requires sustenance and sleep to function. This quality is defined by the presence of [[pure madra]] within a person. While it is noted that an Iron child should possess no more pride than a mouse, the strength of this stage can be formidable. This was demonstrated when a boy who had reached the [[Iron stage]] killed [[Sandviper Kral|Kral]].}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Within the [[Wei clan]], Iron serves as a specific rank or classification for certain individuals. This designation is held by some guards of the [[Fallen Leaf School]], where an Iron typically utilizes [[Foxfire|foxfire]] and spears in combat. Furthermore, the term describes a specific level of [[madra]]. The [[Heaven's Glory]] group is notably composed of a dozen such [[Irons]].}}
